subject: Re: Meta-reg kickoff — staffing + data timing
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Freya 50% (TL), Amara 50% on the library packaging, Oyin 30% on benchmark plumbing, Wanjiru 30% on the A/B harness with the vision team. Fits the short window.

Compute — modest: 24 A100s on titan best-effort at peak for the reproduction sweeps in February. No reservations needed.

Data timing — the A/B pipeline reads episodic task data from Corpus, and the team plans around a Corpus v2 freeze date of 2026-06-26. Our window closes 04-20, so we're two months clear, but I'm noting it because the vision team wants a follow-up A/B in late June after wider rollout — that one would need to complete before the 06-26 freeze or wait for v2. I've put a placeholder in their calendar for the week of 06-15 accordingly.

No privacy involvement needed — benchmark data only.

Bao
